title: Kamindu guides Kaps to crucial LPL win
byline: Colombo Kaps boosted their Lanka Premier League 2026 playoff hopes after holding their nerve to defeat Dambulla Sixers by four wickets in a high-scoring contest at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium on Wednesday

title: Don’t Put Judges in a Difficult Position: Opposition MP
byline: While noting that a time will come when judges in Sri Lanka will have to deliver a judgement on themselves, Opposition MP Dayasiri Jayasekera yesterday said they would be called upon to make a determination on a proposal to extend their retirement age by two years, a decision that would benefit them.

title: Wild Elephants push down garden wall to eat jak
byline: Three wild elephants which had entered Sigiriya town in the early hours of last morning had pushed down a parapet wall of a home garden to eat jak fruit from a tree.

title: NPP cannot take disciplinary action against me : Lal Wijenayake
byline: National Peoples Power (NPP) cannot take disciplinary action against me as I have not gone against any decision made by the party, NPP executive committee member Lal Wijenayake said yesterday.

title: Ministry directs CAA to intensifies action against overpriced blood tests at private hospitals
byline: While expressing concern over reports that some private hospitals are charging patients above the government-approved prices for Full Blood Count (FBC) tests, the Ministry of Health has directed relevant authorities to intensify inspections and raids on private healthcare institutions.

title: Late IGP borrowed security officer’s weapon, claiming he wanted to examine it: Court told
byline: The security officer of the late IGP C.D. Wickramaratne, testifying at the magisterial inquiry into the death of the former IGP, told court that the late IGP had borrowed his duty weapon and ammunition, claiming that he wanted to examine it.

title: Fleet of 104 Metro buses arrives
byline: Another fleet of 104 new buses for Metro Transit, a subsidiary of the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB), has arrived in the country.

title: Govt should be judged by its actions
byline: Responding to a question on whether the government is determined to proceed with extending the retirement age of superior court judges, Justice Minister Harshana Nanayakkara said that the government should be judged by its actions.

title: US launches ’heavy’ strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
byline: The US military says it launched ’’heavy’’ strikes against Iran on Wednesday in retaliation for attempted Iranian ballistic missile attacks on American forces.

title: Myanmar court sentences activists to 37 years over election protest
byline: Myanmar courts have sentenced nine activists to up to 37 years in prison for participating in a protest that urged the public to boycott last December’s elections.

title: Palitha Bandara wins Sri Lanka’s first medal at 2026 Commonwealth Games
byline: Sri Lanka’s Palitha Bandara secured the country’s first medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games after claiming silver in the men’s discus throw F42-44/F61-64 para athletics final.

title: Sri Lanka-US diplomatic ties stronger than ever: Mahinda Samarasinghe
byline: Sri Lanka’s Ambassador to the United States, Mahinda Samarasinghe, said diplomatic cooperation between Sri Lanka and the United States has grown stronger than ever during his tenure, resulting in significant progress in the country’s economic development.

title: Uefa to hold emergency meeting over Fifa World Cup plans
byline: Uefa will hold an emergency meeting on Thursday afternoon to discuss its response to the controversial World Cup stakeholder plans proposed by Fifa and its president Gianni Infantino.

title: Dengue cases surpass 84,000
byline: Sri Lanka has recorded 84,091 dengue cases so far this year, with the dengue-related death toll reaching 61, according to the National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU).

title: Rahane calls time on cricket
byline: Ajinkya Rahane has announced his retirement from all forms of cricket, bringing the curtain down on a remarkable career. The elegant right-hander represented India in 195 international matches across all formats, leaving behind a legacy of resilience, leadership and memorable performances, particularly in Test cricket.

title: Minister assures uninterrupted water supply for next three months
byline: There is no need for water cuts at present as the Labugama and Kalatuwawa reservoirs hold enough water to meet demand for the next three months, Housing, Construction and Water Supply Minister Susil Ranasinghe said.

title: Australia sues Telegram over failure to remove terrorist content
byline: Australia’s online safety regulator has sued Telegram, alleging that the messaging platform failed to detect and remove terrorist executions, mass shootings and other unlawful material.

title: Ranil visits Bhutan
byline: Former President Ranil Wickremesinghe is currently in Bhutan on a private visit, a spokesman from his office said today.

title: Two killed after cab crashes against tree in Vavuniya
byline: Two persons were killed after a cab transporting vegetables crashed against a tree in the Kanagarayankulam area along the Jaffna–Kandy main road in Vavuniya early today, police said.

title: Singapore fines French teen $465 for viral straw-licking stunt
byline: A Singapore court has fined a French student S$600 ($465; £348) for licking a straw from an orange juice vending machine and putting it back into its dispenser.

title: Red warning issued for strong winds, rough seas
byline: The Department of Meteorology has issued a red warning for strong winds and rough seas off the coasts extending from Kankesanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar and from Hambantota to Pottuvil.

title: Sri Lanka collects over 43 containers of plastic pellets from MSC Elsa 3 spill
byline: The Marine Environment Protection Authority (MEPA) said that more than 43 containers worth of plastic pellets which washed ashore following the sinking of the MSC Elsa 3 vessel off the Kerala coast had been collected so far.

title: Ministry directs CAA to intensify action against overpriced blood tests at private hospitals
byline: While expressing concern over reports that some private hospitals are charging patients above the government-approved prices for Full Blood Count (FBC) tests, the Ministry of Health has directed relevant authorities to intensify inspections and raids on private healthcare institutions.

title: Glasgow Commonwealth Games Kalinga Kumarage qualifies for 400m  Semi-finals
byline: Sri Lankan sprinter Kalinga Kumarage booked his place in the men’s 400m semi-finals at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games after an impressive performance in the opening round.

title: New Zealand great and IPL coach wins England coaching role
byline: England have confirmed that former New Zealand captain Stephen Fleming has been appointed as their new head coach of the Test side.

title: Anglican Church of Sri Lanka opposes move to extend judges’ retirement age
byline: The Church of Ceylon (Anglican Church of Sri Lanka) today opposed the government’s move to extend the retirement age of appellate court judges and urged it to withdraw the proposed constitutional amendment.

title: Jerome Fernando meets followers in Australia
byline: Jerome Fernando, more popularly known as ‘Prophet Jerome’ amongst his followers, undertook a visit to Australia recently, where he led several services and prayers for his Australian and international followers.

title: Court of Appeal fixes beer production petition for October 2
byline: The Court of Appeal today ordered that a writ petition seeking an order restraining the Excise Commissioner General and other relevant authorities from approving the use of rice and sugar as primary ingredients in beer production be taken up on October 2 for the filing of objections.

title: Suwa Seriya to launch motorcycle emergency medical service
byline: The 1990 Suwa Seriya Foundation has decided to introduce a motorcycle-based emergency medical service aimed at reaching patients requiring urgent medical attention more quickly and efficiently.

title: Parliament to debate committee report on cybercrime next week
byline: Parliament will hold an Adjournment Debate, moved by the Opposition, on the report of the Committee on Public Finance concerning the fraud linked to cybercrime in relation to the USD 2.5 million debt repayment to Australia, the Communication Department of Parliament said.

title: Rathna Sri Wijesinghe steps down as National Library Board chairman
byline: Veteran lyricist Rathna Sri Wijesinghe has resigned from his position as Chairman of the National Library and Documentation Services Board.

title: FIFA opens disciplinary cases against Argentina
byline: FIFA has lodged disciplinary charges against two Argentina players for their behaviour towards Spanish players after losing the World Cup final, as well as showing a political banner about the Falkland Islands after beating England in the semifinals.

title: Sugeeshwara Bandara further remanded
byline: The Colombo Fort Magistrate’s Court today ordered former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa’s former Private Secretary, Sugeeshwara Lenin Bandara, to be further remanded till August 12 over allegations of criminal misappropriation of funds allocated under the Presidential Expenditure Head.

title: Death toll from Japan’s earthquake rises to 30
byline: Residents of Japan’s southwestern prefecture of Kumamoto were struggling to get their lives back to normal on Thursday, two days after a powerful 7.1 magnitude earthquake set off an explosion at a mall, toppled a factory chimney and flattened homes, killing at least 30 people in the process, as search and rescue efforts continue.

title: Wendy’s joins Sri Lanka’s fast-food race through JKH
byline: John Keells Holdings PLC (JKH) will bring the global fast-food chain Wendy’s to Sri Lanka, marking the diversified conglomerate’s entry into the quick-service restaurant segment.

title: Unidentified object lands deep inside Poland causing explosion as Russia launches deadly, Ukraine-wide attack
byline: An unidentified object crashed and caused an explosion about 90 kilometers (55 miles) into Polish territory early Thursday, local authorities said, as Russia launched deadly longe-range attacks across Ukraine.

title: Two held over Bellanwila shooting under 90-day detention order
byline: Two suspects arrested in connection with the fatal shooting of a restaurant owner near the Bellanwila walking path have been handed over to the Western Province South Crime Investigation Division for further investigations under a 90-day detention order.

title: Attack on northwest Pakistan police post kills 11 officers
byline: An ambush on a police checkpoint in Pakistan’s northwestern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province has killed at least 11 police officers and injured dozens, according to local authorities.

title: Charith Abeysinghe released after fulfilling bail conditions
byline: Former Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Horana electorate organiser Charith Abeysinghe was released from remand custody today (30) after fulfilling the bail conditions imposed by the Colombo Magistrate’s Court.

title: US launches ’heavy’ strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
byline: The US military says it has completed a ’’heavy wave’’ of strikes against Iran in retaliation for Tuesday’s attempted ballistic missile attacks on American forces.

title: Suspended Police Sub-Inspector arrested over alleged money laundering
byline: A suspended Police Sub-Inspector was arrested on Thursday by officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) over allegations of illegally depositing money into bank accounts and engaging in money laundering.

title: Rumesh Tharanga storms into Commonwealth Games Javelin final
byline: Sri Lanka’s javelin sensation Rumesh Tharanga booked his place in the men’s javelin throw final at the Commonwealth Games 2026 after producing an impressive throw of 82.84 metres to top the qualification round.

title: Defence Secretary calls for stronger fight against human trafficking and online exploitation
byline: Warning that human trafficking is rapidly evolving through cyber-enabled scams and deceptive online operations, Secretary to the Ministry of Defence and Chairman of the National Anti-Human Trafficking Task Force, Air Vice Marshal Sampath Thuyacontha (Retd), today called for a united national response to protect victims and dismantle criminal networks, marking the World Day Against Trafficking in Persons 2026.

title: CAA cracks down on sale of non-SLS certified motorcycle helmets
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has intensified its islandwide crackdown on the manufacture and sale of motorcycle helmets that do not carry the mandatory Sri Lanka Standards (SLS) certification mark, seizing hundreds of non-compliant helmets and halting the sale of thousands more.

title: Nearly 10,000 heat-related deaths in Germany so far this year, says institute
byline: An estimated 9,800 people across Germany have ​died so far this ‌year due to heat-related causes, said Germany’s RKI health body ​in its weekly report ​on Thursday, as temperatures of ⁠more than 40 degrees ​Celsius are expected to hit ​several regions.

title: Colombo High Court drops PTA charges against ’Harak Kata’
byline: The Colombo High Court has ruled that charges brought under the Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA) against notorious organized crime figure Nadun Chinthaka Wickramaratne, popularly known as ’’Harak Kata,’’ and four other defendants cannot be maintained.

title: Uefa to boycott World Cups if Fifa plans approved
byline: The decision was made at an emergency meeting called to discuss the proposals announced by Fifa - world football’s governing body - on Tuesday.

title: Attack on northwest Pakistan police post kills 11 officers
byline: An ambush on a police checkpoint in Pakistan’s northwestern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province has killed at least 11 police officers and injured dozens, according to local authorities.
